articles.summary: Mission Produce, Inc. today announced it will bring new category insight to the International Fresh Produce Association (IFPA) Foodservice Conference in Monterey, Calif., July 23–24, 2026, spotlighting the growing opportunity avocados hold as protein reshapes how consumers shop and eat. MISSION PRODUCE® SPOTLIGHTS AVOCADOS' ROLE IN THE PROTEIN BOOM AT IFPA FOODSERVICE
articles.title: Mission Produce® Spotlights Avocados’ Role in the Protein Boom at IFPA Foodservice

articles.summary: While avocados aren’t a high-protein food themselves, they show up big time in the carts of protein shoppers.
articles.title: The Protein Boom—Unlocking Opportunity for Avocados
